title: The Origin: Boys Planet
desc: Born from the survival show 'Boys Planet'. Nine members were selected: Hanbin, Jiwoong, Zhang Hao, Matthew, Taerae, Ricky, Gyuvin, Gunwook, & Yujin. The name ZB1 means 'starting from zero and growing into one together with fans'.

title: Debut & Monster Rookie
desc: Debuted on July 10 with 'Youth in the Shade' (Title Track: In Bloom). Instantly broke records as the fastest 'Million Seller' and dominated global charts, establishing ZB1 as a true 'Monster Rookie'.

title: First Fan-Con @ Gocheok
desc: Just one month after debut, ZB1 held their first Fan-Con at Gocheok Sky Dome, a legendary venue in Korea. All 18,000 seats sold out, proving the immense power of their fandom.

title: Musical Evolution
desc: Released consecutive hits such as 'Melting Point', 'You Had Me at HELLO', and 'Cinema Paradise'. They built a strong musical identity centered on youth, hope, and emotion.

title: Japan Domination
desc: Made their Japanese debut with 'Yura Yura' and held a Japan Fan-Con at K-Arena Yokohama. Their EP 'PREZENT' (2025) topped the Oricon Chart, strengthening their position in the Japanese market.

title: Fan-Con: Blue Mansion
desc: Held a special Fan-Con themed 'Blue Mansion' to celebrate the release of the EP 'Blue Paradise'. Featuring an elegant and mysterious concept with interactive stages that captivated ZEROSE.

title: 1st Full Album: Never Say Never
desc: Released their first full album, 'Never Say Never'. It reached No. 23 on the Billboard 200 and sold over 1.5 million copies — a monumental achievement in their global career.

title: OST & Cinematic Vocals
desc: Actively participated in drama OSTs and collaboration projects, reinforcing their image as idols with strong emotional vocals and a cinematic sound.

title: Global Tours
desc: Successfully completed the Asia Tour 'Timeless World' (2024) and the World Tour 'HERE & NOW' (2025). Known for stable live performances, strong storytelling, and warm interactions with ZEROSE.

title: Awards & Records
desc: Won 'Rookie of the Year', 'Best New Male Artist', and various global popularity awards. ZB1 is one of the fastest and most consistent-achieving 5th generation groups.

title: The Future with ZEROSE
desc: Project contract lasts approximately 2.5 years (until early 2026). However, promotions have been temporarily extended to create meaningful final memories, with further extension discussions ongoing.
